## Summary

A clear, one-line description of the feature.

## Problem / Motivation

What problem does this solve? Who benefits and how?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like. Include UI/UX details if applicable.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative approaches you considered and why you ruled them out.

## Additional Context

Mockups, references, or any other context that would help scope this feature.
